ValidationRule.description: INC0116272 opened edit access to Opportunity field for Tanium Standard Users. INC0131558 create validation rule that limits edit access to DSA, DD, or OO only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ($Profile.Name = 'Tanium Standard User' && $User.Title <> 'Director of Strategic Accounts') || ($Profile.Name = 'Tanium Deals Desk' && !ISPICKVAL($User.Role_Category__c, 'Deal Desk') && !ISPICKVAL($User.Role_Category__c, 'Finance'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The hardware delivery questionnaire should be assigned to the opportunity by the DSA. If you need assistance, please contact the DSA or hardware@tanium.com.
